Turkish · 1,000 words

Turkish words 201–300

Turkish words 201 to 300, by how often they're used, each with its meaning in English, an example sentence and, for verbs, the main forms (he, she or it). 87 of them are taught in the lessons of the course.

Learn them with spaced repetition, Anki-style: open the flashcards. Free, no account needed.

Overview1–100101–200201–300301–400401–500501–600601–700701–800801–900901–1000
  1. 201
    polisnoun

    police officer; the police

    Hemen polisi ara!

    Call the police right away!

    One word for an officer and for the force: Polis geldi (The police came). Polis karakolu = police station.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 3: Saying who you are

  2. 202
    öğrenmekverb

    to learn; to find out

    Türkçe öğrenmek istiyorum.

    I want to learn Turkish.

    aorist öğrenir · present öğreniyor · past öğrendi · future öğrenecek

    Also to find out: Doğruyu öğrendim (I found out the truth). To teach is öğretmek.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 6: The present continuous· Conjugation

  3. 203
    kardeşnoun

    brother or sister, sibling

    Kaç kardeşin var?

    How many brothers and sisters do you have?

    Erkek kardeş (brother) and kız kardeş (sister) usually mean younger ones; an older brother is ağabey (said abi), an older sister abla.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 9: My family

  4. 204
    unutmakverb

    to forget; to leave behind

    Şemsiyeni unutma, yağmur yağıyor.

    Don't forget your umbrella, it's raining.

    aorist unutur · present unutuyor · past unuttu · future unutacak

    With a place it means to leave behind: Telefonumu evde unuttum (I left my phone at home).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 8: Definite objects· Conjugation

  5. 205
    söznoun

    word; promise; remark

    Söz veriyorum, yarın gelirim.

    I promise, I'll come tomorrow.

    Söz vermek = to promise; söz konusu = in question. A single dictionary word is usually kelime.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 2: Used to, was going to, should have

  6. 206
    habernoun

    news; word, message

    Güzel bir haberim var!

    I've got some good news!

    Haberler = the news (on TV). Haber vermek = to let someone know; Ne haber? = What's up?

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 2: Was, were, and once upon a time

  7. 207
    diğeradjective

    other; the other

    Diğer odada kim var?

    Who's in the other room?

    Usually with a definite noun: diğer kapı (the other door). For another, a different one, use başka: başka bir kapı.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 5: The subject participle

  8. 208
    yazmakverb

    to write

    Ona bir mektup yazıyorum.

    I'm writing her a letter.

    aorist yazar · present yazıyor · past yazdı · future yazacak

    The person you write to takes the dative: bana yaz. Mesaj yazmak = to text.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 6: The present continuous· Conjugation

  9. 209
    yemeknoun

    food; meal; dish

    Yemek hazır, gelin!

    Dinner's ready, come and eat!

    The same word is the verb yemek (to eat). Yemek yapmak = to cook; akşam yemeği = dinner.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 6: The present continuous· Conjugation

  10. 210
    tekraradverb

    again; once more

    Lütfen tekrar söyler misiniz?

    Could you say that again, please?

    Tekrar etmek = to repeat. Yine also means again.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 12: Requests and company

  11. 211
    özür dilemekverb

    to apologize

    Özür dilerim, geç kaldım.

    I'm sorry I'm late.

    aorist özür diler · present özür diliyor · past özür diledi · future özür dileyecek

    The person you apologize to takes the ablative: Senden özür dilerim. The e becomes i before -(I)yor: özür diliyor.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 1: Letters and sounds· Conjugation

  12. 212
    açmakverb

    to open; to turn on, to switch on; to answer (the phone)

    Pencereyi açar mısın? Çok sıcak.

    Could you open the window? It's very hot.

    aorist açar · present açıyor · past açtı · future açacak

    Işığı açmak = to turn on the light; telefonu açmak = to answer the phone. The opposite is kapatmak.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 10: Whose is it?· Conjugation

  13. 213
    götürmekverb

    to take (somewhere); to take away

    Çocukları okula götürüyorum.

    I'm taking the kids to school.

    aorist götürür · present götürüyor · past götürdü · future götürecek

    Takes someone or something away from here; to bring here is getirmek.

    A2· Conjugation

  14. 214
    üçnumber

    three

    Üç gün sonra dönüyorum.

    I'm coming back in three days.

    Üçüncü = third.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 11: Numbers and time

  15. 215
    sağnoun

    right, right-hand side; alive; healthy, well

    Sağa dönün, banka orada.

    Turn right, the bank is there.

    Sağa = to the right, sağda = on the right. Sağ ol (thanks) means be well, and sağ also means alive: Dedem hâlâ sağ.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 7: To and from

  16. 216
    çıkarmakverb

    to take out, to remove; to take off (clothes); to bring out, to produce

    Ayakkabılarını kapıda çıkar, lütfen.

    Please take your shoes off at the door.

    aorist çıkarır · present çıkarıyor · past çıkardı · future çıkaracak

    The causative of çıkmak: Ceketini çıkar (Take off your jacket), cebinden çıkardı (he took it out of his pocket).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 6: Must and need· Conjugation

  17. 217
    görepostposition

    according to; in (someone's) opinion; for, suited to

    Bana göre bu film çok güzel.

    In my opinion, this movie is very good.

    After the dative: bana göre (in my opinion), haberlere göre (according to the news).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 9: Where and when: postpositions

  18. 218
    kesmekverb

    to cut; to cut off, to stop; to interrupt

    Ekmeği sen keser misin?

    Could you cut the bread?

    aorist keser · present kesiyor · past kesti · future kesecek

    Saçını kestirmek = to get a haircut. Kes sesini! = Shut up! (rude)

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 11: Causative and reciprocal· Conjugation

  19. 219
    birlikteadverb

    together; together with (ile birlikte)

    Birlikte sinemaya gidiyoruz.

    We're going to the movies together.

    With ile: annemle birlikte (together with my mom). Beraber means the same.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 12: Requests and company

  20. 220
    içeriadverb

    inside, in; indoors

    İçeri gel, dışarısı çok soğuk.

    Come in, it's very cold outside.

    İçeride = inside (where), içeriden = from inside. The opposite is dışarı.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 6: Must and need

  21. 221
    aslaadverb

    never; not at all

    Seni asla unutmam.

    I'll never forget you.

    Used with a negative verb, and stronger than hiç. On its own: Asla! (Never!)

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 4: Habits and truths: the aorist

  22. 222
    oturmakverb

    to sit, to sit down; to live (somewhere); to stay

    Nerede oturuyorsunuz?

    Where do you live?

    aorist oturur · present oturuyor · past oturdu · future oturacak

    The everyday word for where you live: Kadıköy'de oturuyorum. Oturun, lütfen = Please have a seat.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 10: Whose is it?· Conjugation

  23. 223
    değişmekverb

    to change

    Burası çok değişti.

    This place has changed a lot.

    aorist değişir · present değişiyor · past değişti · future değişecek

    Something changes by itself; to change something is değiştirmek.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 2: Used to, was going to, should have· Conjugation

  24. 224
    aslındaadverb

    actually; in fact

    Aslında haklısın.

    Actually, you're right.

    Often corrects what was said or expected: Aslında ben de bilmiyorum (Actually, I don't know either).

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 2: As if

  25. 225
    lazımadjective

    necessary, needed

    Bana biraz para lazım.

    I need some money.

    The person who needs it takes the dative: Sana ne lazım? (What do you need?). After a verb noun it means must: gitmem lazım (I have to go).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 6: Must and need

  26. 226
    hazıradjective

    ready; ready-made

    Kahvaltı hazır!

    Breakfast is ready!

    Hazır mısın? = Are you ready? Hazırlamak = to prepare.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 3: Saying who you are

  27. 227
    dışarıadverb

    out, outside; outdoors

    Bu akşam dışarı çıkıyoruz.

    We're going out tonight.

    Dışarıda = outside (where), dışarıdan = from outside. The opposite is içeri.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 7: Let's: suggestions and wishes

  28. 228
    yoksaconjunction

    or (in questions); otherwise, or else

    Çay mı istersin, yoksa kahve mi?

    Would you like tea or coffee?

    In questions it offers a second choice. In statements it means otherwise: Acele et, yoksa geç kalırız (Hurry up, or we'll be late).

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 9: Conditionals

  29. 229
    bahsetmekverb

    to talk about; to mention

    Neden bahsediyorsun?

    What are you talking about?

    aorist bahseder · present bahsediyor · past bahsetti · future bahsedecek

    What you talk about takes the ablative: senden bahsetti (she talked about you). t becomes d before a vowel: bahsediyor.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 4: Verbal nouns· Conjugation

  30. 230
    erkeknoun

    man; male; boy

    Bebeğiniz kız mı, erkek mi?

    Is your baby a girl or a boy?

    accusative erkeği

    Also an adjective, male: erkek kardeş (brother), erkek arkadaş (boyfriend). k becomes ğ before a vowel: erkeği.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 5: The subject participle

  31. 231
    yineadverb

    again; still, anyway (yine de)

    Yine mi geç kaldın?

    You're late again?

    Yine de = still, all the same: Yorgunum ama yine de geliyorum.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 11: While and then

  32. 232
    fikirnoun

    idea; opinion

    Bu çok iyi bir fikir.

    That's a really good idea.

    accusative fikri

    The second i drops before a vowel: fikri, fikrim. Hiçbir fikrim yok = I have no idea.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 7: Let's: suggestions and wishes

  33. 233
    benceadverb

    in my opinion, I think

    Bence bu kırmızı daha güzel.

    I think the red one is nicer.

    Sence? = What do you think? Built from ben + -cA (according to).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 12: Word building

  34. 234
    geçirmekverb

    to spend (time); to go through, to have (an illness, an accident)

    Çok iyi vakit geçirdik.

    We had a really good time.

    aorist geçirir · present geçiriyor · past geçirdi · future geçirecek

    İyi vakit geçirmek = to have a good time; kaza geçirmek = to have an accident.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 7: Converbs I: when, by, without· Conjugation

  35. 235
    oğulnoun

    son

    Bir kızları, bir de oğulları var.

    They have a daughter and a son.

    accusative oğlu · plural oğullar

    The u drops before a vowel: oğlu, oğlum. Oğlum is also a fond way to address a boy.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 9: My family

  36. 236
    bebeknoun

    baby; doll

    Bebek uyuyor, sessiz olun.

    The baby's asleep, be quiet.

    accusative bebeği

    k becomes ğ before a vowel: bebeği. Bebeğim (my baby) is also an endearment.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 11: Causative and reciprocal

  37. 237
    uzunadjective

    long; tall

    Kardeşim benden daha uzun.

    My brother is taller than me.

    For people, tall: uzun boylu. The opposite is kısa.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 4: Questions and negation

  38. 238
    üstnoun

    top, upper part; on, above (üstünde)

    Telefonun masanın üstünde.

    Your phone is on the table.

    his, her, its üstü

    Mostly with endings: üstünde (on, above), üstüne (onto). Üst kat = upstairs.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 9: Where and when: postpositions

  39. 239
    kaybetmekverb

    to lose

    Anahtarlarımı kaybettim.

    I've lost my keys.

    aorist kaybeder · present kaybediyor · past kaybetti · future kaybedecek

    Written as one word. t becomes d before a vowel: kaybediyor. Kayıp = lost; a loss.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 1: The past tense· Conjugation

  40. 240
    koymakverb

    to put, to place

    Çantanı masaya koy.

    Put your bag on the table.

    aorist koyar · present koyuyor · past koydu · future koyacak

    Where something goes takes the dative: buzdolabına koymak (to put in the fridge).

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 8: Definite objects· Conjugation

  41. 241
    hoşadjective

    pleasant, nice; lovely

    Ne hoş bir sürpriz!

    What a nice surprise!

    In hoş geldin (welcome) and hoşça kal (goodbye). Hoşuma gidiyor = I like it.

    A2

  42. 242
    vurmakverb

    to hit, to strike; to shoot

    Kardeşine vurma!

    Don't hit your brother!

    aorist vurur · present vuruyor · past vurdu · future vuracak

    One of the few one-syllable verbs with the aorist in -Ir: vurur. The one hit takes the dative: ona vurdu. In films, often to shoot.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 4: Habits and truths: the aorist· Conjugation

  43. 243
    kafanoun

    head; mind

    Kafam çok karışık.

    I'm really confused.

    More casual than baş. Kafam karıştı = I'm confused (literally my head got mixed up).

    A2

  44. 244
    tatlıadjective

    sweet; cute, lovely; dessert

    Çok tatlı bir kızınız var.

    You have a very sweet daughter.

    As a noun, dessert: Tatlı ne var? (What's for dessert?). Tatlım = sweetie.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 12: Requests and company

  45. 245
    zatenadverb

    already; anyway, in any case

    Zaten biliyorum.

    I already know.

    Says something was already so, or adds anyway: Zaten geç oldu (It's late anyway).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 1: The past tense

  46. 246
    cannoun

    life, soul; dear, darling (canım)

    Canım çok sıkılıyor.

    I'm really bored.

    Canım = my dear, darling. Canım sıkılıyor = I'm bored; canım … istiyor = I feel like …: Canım dondurma istiyor.

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 9: Everyday colloquial Turkish

  47. 247
    birkaçdeterminer

    a few, several

    Birkaç gün İzmir'de kalıyoruz.

    We're staying in Izmir for a few days.

    The noun stays singular: birkaç gün. Birkaçı = a few of them.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 11: Numbers and time

  48. 248
    korkmakverb

    to be afraid, to be scared; to fear

    Köpeklerden korkuyorum.

    I'm afraid of dogs.

    aorist korkar · present korkuyor · past korktu · future korkacak

    What you fear takes the ablative: köpekten korkmak. Korkma! = Don't be afraid!

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 7: To and from· Conjugation

  49. 249
    odanoun

    room

    Odam küçük ama çok güzel.

    My room is small but really nice.

    Yatak odası = bedroom; oturma odası = living room.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 5: Where things are

  50. 250
    sorunoun

    question

    Bir sorum var.

    I have a question.

    Soru sormak = to ask a question.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 9: My family

  51. 251
    silahnoun

    weapon; gun

    Silahını bırak!

    Drop your gun!

    Frequent in crime films. Silahlı = armed.

    B1

  52. 252
    doktornoun

    doctor

    Yarın doktora gidiyorum.

    I'm going to the doctor tomorrow.

    Hekim is the formal word.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 3: Saying who you are

  53. 253
    telefonnoun

    phone, telephone; phone call

    Telefonun çalıyor.

    Your phone is ringing.

    Telefon etmek = to phone; telefonu açmak = to answer.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 2: Vowel harmony and plurals

  54. 254
    pekadverb

    very, quite; (not) very, (not) really

    Bugün pek iyi değilim.

    I'm not feeling too well today.

    Mostly with a negative: pek değil (not really). Pek çok = a great many.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 8: Comparing

  55. 255
    kaçmakverb

    to run away, to escape; to slip away, to sneak off

    Köpek bahçeden kaçtı.

    The dog ran away from the garden.

    aorist kaçar · present kaçıyor · past kaçtı · future kaçacak

    The place you escape from takes the ablative: evden kaçmak. Kaç! = Run!

    B2First taught in B2 · Unit 6: Compound verbs· Conjugation

  56. 256
    farknoun

    difference

    İkisi arasında ne fark var?

    What's the difference between the two?

    Fark etmek = to notice; Fark etmez = It doesn't matter.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 9: Conditionals

  57. 257
    olaynoun

    event, incident; matter, thing

    Dün gece burada bir olay oldu.

    There was an incident here last night.

    In speech, Olay ne? = What's going on?

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 1: Past continuous and pluperfect

  58. 258
    sesnoun

    sound, noise; voice; volume

    Televizyonun sesini kısar mısın?

    Could you turn the TV down?

    Sesi açmak = to turn it up; sesi kısmak = to turn it down. Sessiz = quiet.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 5: Can and can't

  59. 259
    kazanmakverb

    to win; to earn

    Maçı kim kazandı?

    Who won the game?

    aorist kazanır · present kazanıyor · past kazandı · future kazanacak

    Also to earn: Ne kadar kazanıyorsun? (How much do you earn?)

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 1: The past tense· Conjugation

  60. 260
    ortanoun

    middle, centre; medium (adj)

    Odanın ortasında büyük bir masa var.

    There's a big table in the middle of the room.

    his, her, its ortası

    Ortada = in the middle; orta şekerli = medium sweet (coffee).

    A2

  61. 261
    kapınoun

    door; gate

    Kapı açık, içeri gel.

    The door's open, come in.

    Kapıyı çalmak = to knock; kapıcı = building caretaker.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 2: Vowel harmony and plurals

  62. 262
    haftanoun

    week

    Gelecek hafta tatildeyim.

    I'm on vacation next week.

    Hafta sonu = weekend; haftada bir = once a week.

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 1: The past tense

  63. 263
    önnoun

    front; in front of (önünde)

    Seni okulun önünde bekliyorum.

    I'm waiting for you in front of the school.

    his, her, its önü

    Önünde = in front of; ön kapı = front door. Not to be confused with önce (before).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 9: Where and when: postpositions

  64. 264
    oynamakverb

    to play; to act (in a film or play)

    Hafta sonları tenis oynarım.

    I play tennis on weekends.

    aorist oynar · present oynuyor · past oynadı · future oynayacak

    The a becomes u before -(I)yor: oynuyor. Also to act: Bu filmde kim oynuyor? (Who's in this movie?)

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 2: Was, were, and once upon a time· Conjugation

  65. 265
    tanenoun

    piece, item (counting word); grain

    İki tane simit, lütfen.

    Two simits, please.

    A counting word after numbers: üç tane elma (three apples). Kaç tane? = How many?

  66. 266
    ilgiliadjective

    related to, about; interested

    Bu konuyla ilgili bir sorum var.

    I have a question about this.

    After -(y)lA: bununla ilgili (about this, related to this). From ilgi (interest).

    B1

  67. 267
    denemekverb

    to try; to try on; to test

    Bir daha dene!

    Try again!

    aorist dener · present deniyor · past denedi · future deneyecek

    The e becomes i before -(I)yor: deniyor. For clothes, to try on: Bunu deneyebilir miyim?

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 4: Verbal nouns· Conjugation

  68. 268
    eskiadjective

    old (of things); former, ex-

    Bu çok eski bir ev.

    This is a very old house.

    For people, old is yaşlı. Before a noun, former: eski kocası (her ex-husband).

  69. 269
    sunoun

    water

    Biraz su içer misin?

    Would you like some water?

    accusative suyu

    A y comes before a vowel: suyu, suyum. Maden suyu = mineral water.

    A1First taught in A1 · Unit 1: Letters and sounds

  70. 270
    altnoun

    bottom, lower part; under (altında)

    Kedi yatağın altında.

    The cat's under the bed.

    his, her, its altı

    Altında = under; alt kat = downstairs. Not to be confused with altı (six).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 9: Where and when: postpositions

  71. 271
    şansnoun

    luck; chance

    Sınavda iyi şanslar!

    Good luck on your exam!

    İyi şanslar! = Good luck! Şanslı = lucky; şanssız = unlucky.

    B1First taught in B1 · Unit 9: Conditionals

  72. 272
    gereknoun

    need, necessity

    Teşekküre gerek yok.

    No need to thank me.

    accusative gereği

    Gerek yok = there's no need. Like lazım, it can follow a verb noun: gitmem gerek (I need to go).

    A2First taught in A2 · Unit 6: Must and need

  73. 273
    lanetnoun

    curse; damn, damned

    Lanet olsun, yine kaybettik!

    Damn it, we lost again!

    Rude, but common in dubbed films: Lanet olsun! = Damn it! Best avoided in polite company.

    B1

  74. 274
    tarafnoun

    side; direction, way; part

    Otobüs durağı ne tarafta?

    Which way is the bus stop?

    Bu tarafta = on this side; her taraf = everywhere. Tarafından = by (someone).

    A2

  75. 275
    çalmakverb

    to ring; to steal; to play (an instrument); to knock

    Kapı çalıyor, açar mısın?

    Someone's at the door, can you get it?

    aorist çalar · present çalıyor · past çaldı · future çalacak

    Also to steal (Cüzdanımı çaldılar) and to play an instrument (gitar çalmak).

  76. 276
    yaşnoun

    age; year (of age)

    Kaç yaşındasın?

    How old are you?

    Otuz yaşındayım = I'm thirty. Yaşlı = old (of people).

  77. 277
    içmekverb

    to drink; to smoke; to have (soup)

    Ne içmek istersin?

    What would you like to drink?

    aorist içer · present içiyor · past içti · future içecek

    Also to smoke: sigara içmek. Soup is drunk too: çorba içmek.

    More formal than var. What you own takes the dative: bir eve sahip olmak. Sahip alone = owner.

    Yollamak means the same and is a little more casual.

About this list

The words are ranked by how often they come up in film and TV dialogue, so the list leans towards spoken Turkish. Words are listed in their dictionary form (verbs in the infinitive, gelmek), names and fragments are left out, and ranks are estimates rather than exact counts.

The order of the list is adapted from the 2018 Turkish list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, made from the OpenSubtitles2018 corpus via OPUS, and is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. The meanings, example sentences and notes are original to Daily Turkish.
